Aggregate archival source for documents from Kaper's University of Warsaw student file, including the young portrait, University of Warsaw matriculation and study records, and the police certificate of 21 April 1920 recording his religion as Mosaic. No public URL; used with permission / archival consultation.

timelineEvents.title: Baptism
timelineEvents.label: 17 July 1920 · Baptism
timelineEvents.shortDescription: Kaper is baptized at St. Alexander’s parish in Warsaw, marking his conversion to Catholicism.
timelineEvents.longDescription: On July 17, Kaper is baptized at the Roman Catholic Parish of St. Alexander in Warsaw, at the age of 18. The baptism marks his conversion from Judaism to Catholicism.
